name: Instagram Reels

counting.notes: Tightest single-line mobile fold (~55-60 chars) before '...more' due to overlay HUD.

hashtags.excessBehavior: Tags beyond 5 are rejected or ignored (Dec 2025 5-hashtag cap).
hashtags.notes: Pair 3-5 niche hashtags with spoken/on-screen keywords for Reels search indexing.

links.recommendedStrategy: Do not place raw URLs in Reels captions; direct viewers to bio or organic conversation.
links.notes: Reels captions do not hyperlink URLs.

organic.label: IG Reels Organic (14% top, 25% bottom, right action stack)

ad.label: IG Reels Paid Ad (Meta Official: 14% top, 35% bottom + right stack)

oauth.gotcha: Graph API Reels container strictly requires MP4/MOV with moov atom at front (-movflags +faststart), closed GOP, yuv420p, progressive scan, AAC <=48kHz. Videos >3 min lose non-follower discovery recommendations. Meta originality classifiers apply 30-day reach penalty to recycled/aggregated content. 'Trial feeds' test Reels on non-followers first — early watch time and retention determine distribution.

sources: Meta Ads Guide Reels Safe Zones (14% top / 35% bottom / 6% sides)
